title: GPT-Rosalind agents connect genetic perturbations and neuronal signals
summary: Analysis of a CRISPR atlas of mouse brain cells identified differences between Tsc1 and Tsc2 and a possible relationship between DCTN1 and cholesterol regulation. Experts assessed the interpretations, but the proposed mechanisms remain hypotheses to be tested in new experiments.

evidence.tested: Thousands of GPT-Rosalind agents reanalyzed an existing whole-brain CRISPR atlas; they reproduced findings from human analyses, and their novelty and value assessments aligned with blinded human experts.
evidence.unknown: The proposed biological mechanisms still need experiments to test them.
evidence.ai_role: Each agent investigated one gene disruption, searched the literature and proposed explanations; reports were combined into a reasoning atlas.
